steps.label: Mouth
steps.detail: Teeth crush food; salivary amylase starts breaking down starch

steps.label: Oesophagus
steps.detail: Peristaltic movements push the food down to the stomach

steps.label: Stomach
steps.detail: Hydrochloric acid, pepsin and mucus act on the food

steps.label: Small intestine
steps.detail: Digestion is completed and villi absorb the digested food

steps.label: Large intestine
steps.detail: More water is absorbed; waste leaves through the anus
